description: List the SimOptions travel eSIM plans in stock for a trip. With one destination code: the plans its page on simoptions.com lists. With several: the plans that cover every one of them. Destination codes come from destinations_search. Optional filters: shortest validity, least data (unlimited plans always qualify), unlimited data only. Cheapest first, at most 20; total says how many matched. Each plan carries its id (EAN), validity, data, networks per country, 5G, calls, SMS, phone number, whether it can be topped up, operator, price in the asked currency, and its page on simoptions.com, where it is bought.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the prices are in, e.g. "USD" or "EUR". Defaults to the site's own currency.

destinations.description: Destination codes from destinations_search ("FR", "EUR"). One code: the plans its page lists. Several: the plans that cover them all.

minDataGb.description: Least data accepted, in GB. Unlimited plans always qualify.

name: plans_find
title: Find eSIM plans
